## Market backdrop

## Notable moves

### AMZN: -5.11% (z-score -2.2, volume 2.39x normal)

- **Vs. sector and market:** AMZN fell 5.11%; its sector (Consumer Discretionary, XLY) rose 0.31% and the S&P 500 rose 0.15%. That is 5.43 points worse than its sector, an unusual gap for AMZN (z-score -2.7), so the move looks specific to AMZN.
- **Likely why:** A senior executive departure was announced. [Example Financial News](https://news.example.com/2026-10-08/amzn-news)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Coming up

- Thu Oct 8: JPMorgan Chase (JPM): Court hearing in patent case
- Tue Oct 13: Microsoft (MSFT): Court hearing in patent case
